text:
maria.partnerships: Heads-up — Argos demo tomorrow 10:00 PST. Need SI handoff + lead routing confirmed. Who's owning post-demo follow-up?
jamie.si: I can own post-demo nurture for Argos. Will need access to the trial account and a mapping of contacts.
maria.partnerships: @jamie thanks. quick checklist: 1) account mapping CSV 2) who owns legal -> raj? 3) marketplace listing status 4) press/announce plan?
raj.sales: Legal is on me but FYI we need an NDA signed before sharing sensitive configs. Will loop in @linda for contact intros.
linda.field: i'll intro Argos AE to jamie and set a 30m post-demo sync. Also can pull the marketplace listing page link.
sarah.solutions: For demo infra: @jamie — please confirm model variant (redwood-small vs redwood-prod) and whether we enable prefix caching. We should demo on prod-config to match performance.
jamie.si: prefer prod-config. small is faster but not representative for SLOs. I'll leave caching off for demo to show cold start behavior.
maria.partnerships: marketplace status: listing is published but needs co-brand asset (logo + 2-sentence blurb). @linda can you get logo by EOD?
linda.field: got it, pinging Argos legal for logo approval now. ETA 6pm PT.
raj.sales: post-demo rules: if ACV > $50k sales owns, below that SI can lead with our referral fee. Confirm? @maria
maria.partnerships: yes that's our standard: SI-led up to $50k, above that sales/AE steps in. We'll capture in SFDC handoff notes.
deploy-bot: Reminder: demo cluster scheduled to spin up 09:00 PST tomorrow. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/clusters/argos-demo
jamie.si: action items I have: 1) get trial creds from @raj 2) post-demo sync invite from @linda 3) prepare handoff SFDC playbook snippet
maria.partnerships: i'll draft the SFDC handoff snippet and share in #partnerships after this thread. If anyone wants to edit, do so before 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
raj.sales: ack
jamie.si: ack
linda.field: ack
sarah.solutions: ack — i'll be on the demo to handle infra Qs.
maria.partnerships: thanks everyone, keeping this thread for final confirmations. If anything blocks, call me. :raised_hands:
